description:
You've entered a kitchen.

You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a fridge. You can make out a closed oven right there by you. You can see a table. You see a knife on the table. inventory: You are carrying nothing.

---------
Gather all following ingredients and follow the directions to prepare this tasty meal.

purple potato

  orange bell pepper
  red hot pepper

  roast the purple potato
  dice the banana
  fry the banana
  dice the orange bell pepper
  fry the orange bell pepper
  chop the red hot pepper
  fry the red hot pepper
  prepare meal
